name: Shaving Cream
description: TSA rules for shaving cream and shaving gel on planes.

carryOn.reason: Shaving cream, gel, and foam are subject to TSA 3-1-1 liquids rule in carry-on bags. Containers must be 3.4 oz (100ml) or less and fit in a quart-sized clear bag.
conditions: Must fit in a single quart-sized clear zip bag

checkedBag.reason: Full-size shaving cream and gels are allowed in checked baggage without volume restrictions.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring shaving cream on a plane?

travelTips: Buy travel-size shaving cream (under 3.4 oz) for carry-on
Pack full-size cans in your checked bag for longer trips

faq.question: Can I bring shaving cream on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, in carry-on bags shaving cream must be 3.4 oz or less and fit in your quart-size liquids bag. Full sizes are allowed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Is shaving gel allowed on planes?
faq.answer: Yes, same rules apply — 3.4 oz or less in carry-on. Full size is fine in checked baggage.
